title: WarehouseSupplyTermsChanged
description: Published by the business-partner processor when a warehouse's supply terms are created, replaced or deleted. Attributes: Tenant-Id, Correlation-Id, and Event-Id = <businessUnitId>:<apiDatetime>. Ordering key: <tenantId>-<businessUnitId>.

businessUnitId.description: Id of the warehouse business unit the terms apply to

defaultLeadTimeHours.description: Calendar hours from order to delivery. A day-level ERP value is multiplied by 24

minimumOrderQuantity.description: Smallest total quantity, in sellable units, of one order to this source

isDeleted.description: True when the supply terms were deleted

modifiedDatetime.description: When the processor wrote this state. Consumers discard an event older than the state they hold
